scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n nova,runtime,api -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev --workspace @rocketcrab/nova" "npm run dev --workspace @rocketcrab/runtime" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.dev:https: concurrently -k -n nova,runtime,api -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev:https --workspace @rocketcrab/nova -- --host" "npm run dev:https --workspace @rocketcrab/runtime -- --host" "npm run dev:api -- --local-protocol https --https-key-path .certs/localhost-key.pem --https-cert-path .certs/localhost-cert.pem"
scripts.dev:api: npx --yes wrangler@4.161.0 dev --config deploy/nova/wrangler.toml --var TURNSTILE_REQUIRED:false --var CODE_HMAC_SECRET:local-dev-only --assets apps/nova/public
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:api
scripts.test:watch: concurrently -k -n nova,runtime -c blue,magenta "npm run test:watch --workspace @rocketcrab/nova" "npm run test:watch --workspace @rocketcrab/runtime"
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
